description: Checks a certificate SHA-1 fingerprint (40 hex characters) against the abuse.ch SSL Blacklist of certificates seen on malware botnet C2 servers. A hit returns the date added and the malware reason from the list. Only certificates this list tracks are covered. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
